Subject: AirUI UBUS Backend APIs
Acceptance Criteria: Every registered method has schema validation, ACL coverage, hardware verification and documented responses

Subject: System Backend
Acceptance Criteria: System APIs report capabilities and safely manage the WAN address

Subject: System health endpoint
Acceptance Criteria: Returns a valid success envelope and reports availability of all AirUI objects

Subject: System capabilities endpoint
Acceptance Criteria: Returns actual radio and platform capabilities without hardcoded hardware assumptions

Subject: WAN management configuration endpoint
Acceptance Criteria: Returns protocol, address, netmask, gateway, DNS, VLAN and runtime connection state

Subject: WAN management update endpoint
Acceptance Criteria: Validates and applies DHCP, static and VLAN settings while preserving management access
Notes: Parameters: proto, ipaddr, netmask, gateway, dns, vlan_id, dry_run

Subject: Configuration apply-status endpoint
Acceptance Criteria: Reports idle, applying, success, rolled-back and failed configuration states
Notes: Implemented as airui.apply-status.v1; WAN, wireless and interface apply operations publish state

Subject: Status Backend
UBUS Method: summary; overview; device_status; clients; client_disconnect; statistics
Acceptance Criteria: All Status pages consume consistent current device and client data

Subject: Dashboard summary endpoint
Acceptance Criteria: Returns uplink, clients, radios, uptime, CPU, memory, storage and mode from current device data

Subject: Dashboard overview alias
Acceptance Criteria: Returns the same schema and values as summary

Subject: Device status endpoint
Acceptance Criteria: Returns device identity, management network, uplink, radio and serving SSID state

Subject: Connected clients endpoint
Acceptance Criteria: Returns only associated wireless stations and directly connected LAN clients with deduplication
Notes: No parameters; depends on hostapd and stamond identity data

Subject: Wireless client disconnect endpoint
Acceptance Criteria: Disconnects the requested associated MAC and confirms it disappears after refresh
Notes: Validated input, all-BSS temporary deny, deauthentication and station disappearance

Subject: Device statistics endpoint
Acceptance Criteria: Returns CPU, physical core count, load, memory, LAN traffic, radio survey and wireless counters

Subject: Network Interface Backend
Acceptance Criteria: Interface CRUD, validation, SSID mapping and safe apply work on hardware

Subject: Interface configuration endpoint
Acceptance Criteria: Returns UCI and runtime state for supported logical interfaces

Subject: Interface validation endpoint
Acceptance Criteria: Rejects invalid names, VLANs, addresses, DHCP and firewall settings without modifying UCI
Notes: Parameters: type, name, vlan_id, parent_device, bridge_name, proto, ipaddr, netmask, dhcp, firewall, dry_run

Subject: Interface creation endpoint
Acceptance Criteria: Creates the requested VLAN, bridge, network, DHCP and firewall configuration and supports dry-run

Subject: Interface update endpoint
Acceptance Criteria: Updates an existing logical interface without corrupting unrelated configuration

Subject: Interface deletion endpoint
Acceptance Criteria: Deletes the selected interface and handles mapped SSIDs according to the request

Subject: Interface apply and rollback endpoint
Acceptance Criteria: Commits changes, restarts requested services and rolls back when management reachability is lost

Subject: SSID-to-network mapping endpoint
Acceptance Criteria: Maps the selected wireless section to the requested logical network and persists safely

Subject: Wireless Backend
Acceptance Criteria: Radio and SSID operations validate, persist and match runtime state

Subject: Wireless configuration endpoint
Acceptance Criteria: Returns radios, SSIDs, runtime state and enterprise metadata in one stable schema

Subject: Wireless update endpoint
Acceptance Criteria: Updates radio or SSID settings with validation and dry-run support
Notes: Parameters include section, type, device, mode, disabled, ssid, encryption, key, network, channel, htmode, country, hidden, isolate, maxassoc, steering, fairness, rate limits and references

Subject: Wireless SSID creation endpoint
Acceptance Criteria: Creates a unique SSID section with stable VIF identity and valid radio/network mapping
Notes: Parameters: section, type, device, mode, network, ssid, encryption, key, disabled, dry_run

Subject: Wireless SSID deletion endpoint
Acceptance Criteria: Deletes only the selected SSID section and reports validation or apply failures

Subject: LAN/WAN configuration endpoint
Acceptance Criteria: Returns route, uplink and LAN/WAN policy configuration in a documented schema

Subject: LAN/WAN update endpoint
Acceptance Criteria: Validates and applies routing policy with rollback protection
Notes: Currently unsupported placeholder; request schema not defined

Subject: Operating Mode Backend
Acceptance Criteria: Standalone, on-premise and cloud controller workflows use real backend state

Subject: Controller status endpoint
Acceptance Criteria: Reports current mode, config source, discovery, adoption and safe-apply state

Subject: Operating mode configuration API
Acceptance Criteria: Reads and safely switches between standalone and controller-managed operation
Notes: Methods are required but not registered yet

Subject: On-premise controller discovery and connection API
Acceptance Criteria: Discovers or tests a WLC and reports adoption progress and actionable errors
Notes: Methods are required but not registered yet

Subject: Cloud controller activation API
Acceptance Criteria: Claims the AP using organization and activation code without exposing credentials
Notes: Methods are required but not registered yet

Subject: Security Backend
Acceptance Criteria: Security policies validate, enforce and persist per SSID

Subject: Security rules endpoint
Acceptance Criteria: Returns configured access-control rules and effective firewall state

Subject: MAC-filter configuration endpoint
Acceptance Criteria: Returns filter policy and entries for every SSID

Subject: MAC-filter policy update endpoint
Acceptance Criteria: Enables or disables allow/deny policy for the selected SSID and supports dry-run

Subject: MAC-filter entry creation endpoint
Acceptance Criteria: Validates, normalizes and deduplicates MAC entries before persistence

Subject: MAC-filter entry deletion endpoint
Acceptance Criteria: Deletes the selected MAC from only the requested SSID policy

Subject: Maintenance Backend
UBUS Method: config; device_management_*; logs; reboot; factory_reset; firmware_*
Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance operations are validated, guarded and verified on hardware

Subject: Maintenance configuration endpoint
Acceptance Criteria: Returns device, firmware and maintenance capabilities in a stable response

Subject: Device-management read endpoint
Acceptance Criteria: Returns hostname, timezone and zone information

Subject: Device-management update endpoint
Acceptance Criteria: Validates and persists hostname and timezone settings with dry-run support

Subject: System logs endpoint
Acceptance Criteria: Returns bounded, sanitized system logs and reports collection failures

Subject: Device reboot endpoint
Acceptance Criteria: Requires explicit UI confirmation and reboots only when dry-run is false

Subject: Factory-reset endpoint
Acceptance Criteria: Rejects missing confirmation, supports dry-run and performs factory reset only after exact confirmation

Subject: Firmware image validation endpoint
Acceptance Criteria: Validates file existence, format, platform compatibility and upgrade support before enabling upgrade

Subject: Firmware upgrade endpoint
Acceptance Criteria: Requires successful validation and confirmation, honors keep-settings and force options and starts the platform upgrade
Notes: Parameters: path, keep_settings, force, dry_run, confirm

Subject: External UBUS Dependencies
Acceptance Criteria: External calls have ACL coverage, timeout handling and normalized failure responses

Subject: Client identity integration
Acceptance Criteria: Resolves IP address, hostname, OS and client type for a MAC without misclassifying wired or wireless clients
Notes: airui.status clients now includes client_identities; verified live hostname, IP, OS and wireless type

Subject: Hostapd station inventory integration
Acceptance Criteria: Returns authoritative associated stations with RSSI, connection duration and serving band across both radios
Notes: Validated live roaming between phy0 and phy1; stale disassociated records are excluded and MACs are deduplicated

Subject: Hostapd disconnect integration
Acceptance Criteria: Disconnects only a currently associated station and propagates driver errors
Notes: Temporary deny is applied to every active BSS for 60 seconds so dual-band clients cannot roam and reconnect

Subject: Network interface runtime integration
Acceptance Criteria: Returns current link, addresses, routes, uptime and protocol state for the requested logical interface

Subject: Network reload integration
Acceptance Criteria: Reloads network configuration after validation and works with management rollback protection

Subject: Firmware temporary-file integration
Acceptance Criteria: Uploads firmware safely to an approved temporary path, verifies it and removes temporary data after completion or failure
Notes: File operations require restricted ACL paths

Subject: Backend Quality and Contracts
Acceptance Criteria: All methods follow one documented contract and pass automated and hardware tests

Subject: Standardize AirUI response envelope
Acceptance Criteria: Every method returns consistent ok, data, warnings, errors and metadata fields
Notes: Document schema versions and error codes

Subject: Audit UBUS ACL permissions
Acceptance Criteria: Read sessions cannot invoke writes and each UI page has only the minimum required UBUS permissions

Subject: Add dry-run and validation tests
Acceptance Criteria: Invalid inputs never mutate configuration and every supported write method has dry-run coverage
Notes: Include boundary, malformed and command-injection cases

Subject: Add cross-page data consistency tests
Acceptance Criteria: Client counts, CPU, load, memory and uptime agree across endpoints within one polling interval
Notes: AP-side test validates envelopes, uptime tolerance, memory, load, station identity coverage, aggregate CPU counters and derived physical core count

Subject: Protect status pages from stale responses
Acceptance Criteria: Each request has a sequence or generation guard; an older or slower response cannot overwrite newer rendered data; failures preserve the last successful values but mark them stale; leaving the page stops pending poll updates
Notes: Implemented with generation guards and last-successful timestamps

Subject: Add automatic refresh to live pages
Acceptance Criteria: Dashboard, Device Status, Device Statistics and Clients refresh automatically at a documented interval; manual Refresh triggers an immediate request; polling pauses while the page is hidden and resumes when visible; concurrent requests are prevented; Updated text reflects the last successful refresh; repeated failures use bounded retry/backoff
Notes: Implemented at 5 seconds for Dashboard, Device Status and Clients, and 3 seconds for Device Statistics
